BUILDPLAN.md T-12 (M2).

Take it home: the last question with colour, the free-stepping trace, three beats, receipt, options with ✓, container-scroll on a phone

Criteria: AC-33, AC-71, AC-87, AC-95 (count from release), `SPEC.md` §13
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-02, T-11
BUILDPLAN notes: —

Workflow mode: fast-track. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

The existing Surface::Page rule ('pages are compile-time bytes: nothing of any question') cannot hold for /last after release, which is why it needs its own surface rather than UNSCANNED. Default if no answer: I make exactly that edit and list it under deviations.
2) STRINGS not in §11 that /last needs: (a) the no-release page line — I will use 'No question has been released yet.'; (b) the legacy Miri row value §13 describes — 'run separately'; (c) the How-we-know detail row labels from the prototype — 'compiler', 'edition', 'target', 'flags', 'miri'. web/shared/copy.js is out of scope for me, so these live in web/home/home.js marked PROPOSED-§11 and are listed under deviations for §11 to adopt or replace.
